doors.note: US: 3 own doors — South Coast Plaza (Costa Mesa), 650 Madison Ave (New York), Bal Harbour Shops — and 1 concession, 'Bloomingdale's Roger Vivier' at 59th Street. World: 104 boutiques; about 40 sit inside department stores (David Jones, Holt Renfrew, Japanese and Korean department stores, etc.). No phones or US states in the list; the Madison entry carries two ZIPs. No stockist list. Paris label (Tod's group, per the site's cookie text).

craft_evidence.owned: no — no factory named on the brand's pages (owner Tod's Group named in the footer only)
craft_evidence.madein: 100% of readable (8 of 8 sampled PDPs: Made in Italy; 4 more sampled links mis-encoded and not read)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed — Roger Vivier born 1907 in Paris (8th arrondissement); Belle Vivier launched 1965; history timeline page
craft_evidence.process: thin — Rose Vivier page: satin petals 'cut, folded, and stitched individually' by hand; no workshop named
craft_evidence.reasoning: The sampled shoes say Made in Italy and the history timeline is dated and placed (Paris, 1907; Belle Vivier 1965). No factory, maker or tannery is named; the one process passage (hand-stitched satin petals) covers a single capsule. That is a 2.
